clips.title: 朱莉娅·赫尔曼：金融板块遭冷落，但并非缺钱

subtitles.en: Joining us now is Julia Herman, global market strategist at New York Life Investment Management.
subtitles.zh: 现在连线的是纽约人寿**管理的全球市场策略师朱莉娅·赫尔曼。

subtitles.en: Julia, when the Iranians were striking the odd boat here and there, and I don't mean to minimize it, there were definitely strikes happening, the markets were completely ignoring it.
subtitles.zh: 朱莉娅，伊朗此前袭击零散船只时，市场完全无视。

subtitles.en: The president came out at an NATO summit where he had been fluffed off if you like by the leaders, and he made some really derogatory and awful comments about Iran and said that, you know,
subtitles.zh: 总统在北约峰会上被冷落，随后对伊朗发表贬低言论，

subtitles.en: it was very possible that we would continue striking tonight having already struck last night.
subtitles.zh: 称昨晚已打击，今晚可能继续。

subtitles.en: At what point do you really start to take this seriously as a strategist that this is coming back into play again? Well, from the strategy perspective, we're certainly already taking this seriously,
subtitles.zh: 作为策略师，何时开始认真对待？我们已在认真对待，

subtitles.en: because it blows the confidence interval on oil pricing, the knock on impacts on inflation, wide open. So in that sense, we are very much taking this seriously, but we also have to mind
subtitles.zh: 因为这彻底打开了油价和通胀的置信区间。

subtitles.en: what portions of the market have shown really sensitive pricing to these conditions to peace or lack thereof, and where has the move been more sticky? So obviously, oil prices are going to be in
subtitles.zh: 但也要关注市场哪些部分对和平与否敏感，哪些变动更持久。

subtitles.en: that sensitivity bucket, but we've already seen a huge repricing in monetary policy expectations, globally, and the most hawkish scenarios did sort of come off the table when we had these prospects
subtitles.zh: 油价显然敏感，但全球货币政策预期已大幅重估，最鹰派情景有所消退。

subtitles.en: of peace, but not entirely. And so what we're left with is a significantly less supportive monetary environment that we and consensus expected at the start of the year. What does tech and how does tech
subtitles.zh: 目前货币环境比年初预期更不宽松。科技股表现如何？

subtitles.en: perform during this? Because there have been past conflicts where the hyperscalers of the big tech players are seen as like a nice little cushy safety blanket. Every day now, it feels like there's a
subtitles.zh: 过去冲突中，大型科技公司被视为安全毯。现在每天都有新情况。

subtitles.en: violent rotation. Is tech still somewhere that you can flee to for safety in geopolitical conflict?
subtitles.zh: 剧烈轮动。在地缘冲突中，科技股是否仍是避险去处？
